title: proboscidea parviflora subsp. gracillima
intro: Proboscidea parviflora subsp. gracillima, commonly known as Mexican prickly poppy, is a plant species native to Mexico and parts of the southwestern United States. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and promoting wound healing, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides. The bioactive compounds present in Mexican prickly poppy have been shown to exhibit antioxidant and antimicrobial activities, further solidifying its potential as a valuable medicinal plant.
